title: Chintamani Library v2.8.9 — Portal Screenshot Upload & Verification Fix
releaseNotes: PORTAL SCREENSHOT UPLOAD FIX: Resolved Prisma findFirst invocation error during screenshot submission by implementing robust phone sanitization, non-empty guards, and applicant fallback.
PAYMENT VERIFICATION SCREENSHOT PREVIEW: Added inline thumbnail image preview inside pending verification cards with high-res interactive pinch-to-zoom modal.
6-MONTH PAYMENT HISTORY SCREENSHOT: Fixed screenshot display by dynamically resolving server base URL via ApiEndpoints.baseUrl instead of localhost.
CROSS-ORIGIN ASSETS: Configured cross-origin resource policy on static uploads to ensure screenshots render reliably across mobile apps, WebViews, and desktop browsers.
SLIM APK: High-performance split arm64 package (~36 MB) for quick download and instant updates.
